# 03 Compute node positions and edge paths via a dagre-backed layout engine

## Outcome

`layoutGraph(graph, options)` turns a `GraphModel` into a `PositionedGraph`: every node has
deterministic, non-overlapping x/y/width/height, and every edge has a point path connecting node
boundaries (not centers), using `@dagrejs/dagre` internally for rank/position assignment and an
injected `TextMeasurer` for label sizing.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Given a `GraphModel` fixture (nodes `A`, `B`, `C`; edges `A->B`, `B->C`; direction `TD`) and
  a fake deterministic `TextMeasurer` (`width = text.length * 8, height = 24`), `layoutGraph`
  returns a `PositionedGraph` where `B.y > A.y` and `C.y > B.y` (ranks stack downward for `TD`).
- [ ] The same graph with `direction: 'LR'` produces `B.x > A.x` and `C.x > B.x` instead (ranks
  stack rightward).
- [ ] No two nodes' bounding boxes (`x, y, width, height`) overlap.
- [ ] Each edge's path starts on the source node's boundary and ends on the target node's
  boundary — not at the node's center point.
- [ ] Calling `layoutGraph` twice with the same `GraphModel` and the same fake `TextMeasurer`
  produces identical output (deterministic, snapshot-stable).
- [ ] The resolved timeline (pending/visible grouping) from the input `GraphModel` passes through
  unchanged onto `PositionedGraph.timeline`, so the renderer ticket doesn't need to recompute it.

## Test seam

`layoutGraph(graph: GraphModel, options: { measureText: TextMeasurer }): PositionedGraph` — unit
level, pure function, fake deterministic `TextMeasurer` injected (no canvas/DOM needed to test
this module).
